title: CFPC Pattern Style Contract
description: Declares one semantic operation type that CFPC can recognize and compose. Patterns activate on matching intents and generate typed Q factories. promote_generated_facts must remain false until validated through the shadow → authoritative migration path.

intents.description: Which intent names can activate this pattern style

relation.description: Semantic relation type: REQUIRES, CAUSES, SAME_AS, CONTRADICTS, etc.

bindings.description: Named slots this pattern binds (e.g. goal, prerequisite)

expand.description: What to expand on when unresolved (e.g. unresolved_prerequisites)

promote_generated_facts.description: Pattern Induction guard. Must remain false until validated through shadow → authoritative migration.
